web-service-memory: sum(<container memory usage bytes>{<container label>="<frontend container>"})
service-heap-memory: sum(<JVM memory used bytes>{<service label>="<a JVM service>"})
error-rate: sum(rate(<span metrics calls counter>{<status label>="<error status>"}[5m]))
web-service-latency-p99: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le)(rate(<span metrics duration histogram>_bucket{<service label>="<frontend service>"}[5m])))
